name: The Pirate Mermaid
source:
Ever since your father died searching for the mermaids' treasure, you've sworn to fulfill his dream yourself. Becoming a pirate was the bet way of accomplishing that goal...until your mutinous crew dumped you overboard during the biggest storm of the century.

Miraculously, you are saved and find a sorcerer who will make you a magical contract - with a catch. He'll transform you into a mermaid so you can grab the treasure, if you bring him a red vial from the mermaid treasury. If you fail, you'll be turned into a lobster for his dinner.

Now, you have six days before the spell ends. Will you become rich beyond your wildest dreams? Fail the contract and become lobster bisque? Perhaps you'll fall in love w with the mermaid prince or sorcerer...

Or corrupt them into joining your evil pirate ways.

[From [url=https://navigame.itch.io/the-pirate-mermaid]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自从你的父亲为了寻找美人鱼的宝藏而死后，你就发誓要亲自实现他的梦想。成为一名海盗是实现这一目标的必由之路……直到你的叛变船员在本世纪最大的风暴中将你从船上扔了下去。

奇迹般地，你被拯救了，并找到了一位巫师，他将为你签订一份魔法契约——附带一个条件。如果你从美人鱼宝库给他带来一个红色小瓶，他会把你变成美人鱼，这样你就可以抢到宝藏。如果你失败了，你就会变成一只龙虾来吃他的晚餐。

现在，距离咒语结束还有六天时间。你会变得比你最疯狂的梦想更富有吗？合同失败，变成龙虾浓汤？也许你会爱上人鱼王子或魔法师……

或者腐蚀他们加入你邪恶的海盗行列。

[来自[url=https://navigame.itch.io/the-pirate-mermaid]itch.io[/url]]
